author: Will
short: Simple administration logs for members, messages, voice, and server changes.
description: Configurable per-server log channel for joins/leaves, nicknames, roles, profiles, bans, timeouts, message deletions/edits, voice activity, and channel/role/server changes. Deleted text is available only when cached by Red. Long records are preserved as text attachments.
install_msg: Run [p]load adminlog, then [p]adminlog channel #admin-logs. Enable Server Members and Message Content intents. Use [p]adminlog status and [p]adminlog test to check setup.
end_user_data_statement: Persists only each server's log channel ID in Red Config. Sends user IDs, names, nicknames, roles, activity, and available edited/deleted message content and attachment URLs into the configured Discord channel. These Discord records remain until administrators delete them; Red data-deletion requests do not purge them. This cog maintains no additional message cache or per-user database. It uses Red's existing temporary message cache.
